It covers tuition, international travel, subsistence, books and health insurance. There is no direct application: the Admission Office nominates at most two candidates per faculty among applicants who applied before 1 December and hold an admission offer before 1 February; a maximum of four scholarships are awarded each year.
opportunities.program_dates: Master's programme of 12-24 months starting on 1 September (September 2027 for this cycle)

Around the first week of January the Admissions Office selects at most two nominees per faculty, who send an EBF motivation letter within one week; nomination files go to the EBF committee before 1 February and nominees hear the outcome before 1 March. The page prints no year for these dates; for a September 2027 start the next 1 December is 1 December 2026, but no page states that year, so no date is recorded. FEB master's deadline for a September 2027 start: 'you need to apply before 1 May 2027'.

opportunities.title: EU Delegation to the DRC: subsidised internship for young graduates (Political, Press and Information section)
opportunities.organization: Delegation of the European Union to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (EEAS), Kinshasa
opportunities.overview: Subsidised internships of up to six months for young graduates in the Political, Press and Information section of the EU Delegation in Kinshasa. The section follows diplomatic relations between the EU and the DRC and makes the EU's actions in support of the country's development known. The EEAS lists seven calls since February 2022, published at irregular intervals and open 7 to 16 days each. The latest call, for two internships in 2026 with provisional starts in March and October, closed on 25 January 2026.
opportunities.program_dates: Up to six months. Provisional starts in the calls read: April 2022, November 2022, May 2023, April 2024, November 2024, May 2025, and March and October 2026.
opportunities.deadline_text: No call is open. Latest call: published 15.01.2026, 'Délai pour l'envoi des candidatures : 25 janvier 2026.'
opportunities.expected_next_cycle: Irregular, one or two calls a year. The EEAS vacancies list of the EU Delegation in Kinshasa (read 19 November 2026) shows seven calls for this internship, with deadlines 24/02/2022, 09/10/2022, 31/03/2023, 2 February 2024, 26 September 2024, 18.04.2025 and 25 January 2026. Each call page read was published 7 to 16 days before its deadline (11.02.2022, 26.09.2022, 15.03.2023, 24.01.2024, 17.09.2024, 11.04.2025 and 15.01.2026). No call after 25 January 2026 is listed.

opportunities.stipend: Monthly subsistence grant; amount not stated on the call page

opportunities.organization: European Forum Alpbach
opportunities.overview: Scholarships to take part in the annual two-week European Forum Alpbach in the Austrian Alps. The scholarship pays the participation fee and accommodation, not travel. The organiser says applications for the 2027 Forum open in March 2027.

Applicants from all countries and professional or academic backgrounds; non-graduates are welcome

Ready to attend the full duration of the Forum (earliest departure 31 August, only in exceptional approved cases)

opportunities.title: Mauritius-Africa Scholarship Scheme 2027 (MPhil and PhD in Mauritius)
opportunities.organization: Ministry of Tertiary Education, Science and Research, Government of the Republic of Mauritius
opportunities.overview: Government of Mauritius scholarships for resident citizens of African Union member states or African Commonwealth countries to study full-time on campus at a public university in Mauritius from the 2027 intake. For a bachelor's holder the route is an MPhil (research master's) or MPhil/PhD. Applications go through the national nominating agency, which endorses at most 15 candidates per country.

Submit the 2027 application form through the nominating agency of your country, by 'a deadline to be communicated by the Nominating Agency' (it may fall earlier). Monthly living allowance of MUR 16,500 'as part support'; 'Students are expected to supplement this amount'
The awardee buys the ticket to Mauritius and claims a refund after arrival with the original receipts; the scholarship also covers the journey home once the studies are deemed completed

Successful candidates are placed on a roster valid for three years and may be offered a two-year fixed-term contract at P-1 or P-2 level. Reported by secondary sources: the 2026 call is the 'Development and Sustainability' examination (job opening 285586 on careers.un.org) with a deadline of 30 November 2026.
